_note: Phase 3 typing encounter tuning (Sky Remnant at the Dawn Tower). Times are seconds, positions are 640x360 canvas pixels, health is health points. The deck is a finite selection from vocabulary.json; boss health is always deck size x damage_per_word. See docs/star_fall_contract.md section 17.

boss.name: SKY REMNANT
boss.subtitle: Smog-born guardian of the Dawn Project shield

deck._note: Stages run in order inside one fight. Each stage draws `count` entries from one band. fall_seconds is the base time a word takes from the spawn line to the danger line.

pacing._note: Bounded adaptation. When the observed pace needs more than slow_ratio of a fall to finish a word, slow mode limits the field to one word and travel_scale stretches fall time (up to travel_scale_max). gap_scale shortens empty gaps for faster typists. A miss never speeds anything up.

estimate._note: Assumptions for the pre-fight duration estimate only. 1.8 characters per second is roughly 22 words per minute, an assumed adult casual typist, not a measured audience value.
